svg.title: Polyhymnia in an illuminated acanthus frame
svg.desc: The original vector portrait inside a newly drawn red, blue and gold acanthus medallion. The four painted flourishes are individually drawn, balanced without mirror symmetry.

svg.title: Laurel-crowned woman and lyre — aged vector emblem without frame
svg.desc: Source-faithful smooth Bézier paths for the teal portrait, gold laurel and lyre, without the red ornamental frame. Original worn ink is traced into vector transparency. The parchment and all unprinted negative spaces are transparent. The canvas is cropped to the remaining artwork. No raster images or external resources.
